simple.meaning: מְשַׁמָּה (mᵉshammâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a waste or amazement.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מְשַׁמָּה (H4923) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 15:6, with occurrences in Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְשַׁמָּה (H4923) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְשַׁמָּה (H4923) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְשַׁמָּה (mᵉshammâh) / H4923 is traced through Isaiah 15:6, Jeremiah 48:34, Ezekiel 5:15, Ezekiel 6:14 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
